supervisor.value: Name faculty of interest in the application; no prior commitment is needed, but contacting faculty is encouraged.
supervisor.quote: No commitment from a supervisor prior to applying is necessary, but contacting faculty members is encouraged.

funding.value: International PhD students get CAD 46,236 a year (including tuition awards) for four years, plus CAD 34,654 in year five.
funding.quote: All full-time PhD students will receive a funding package of $46,236 per year (this includes all tuition awards, including the International Tuition Award) for international students and $41,653 per year for domestic students during the first four years of their PhD program. | In addition, the department provides guaranteed departmental support of $34,654 per year in the fifth year of the program.

entry_route.value: PhD students normally hold an MSc in computer science or a related area; UBC MSc students can transfer.
entry_route.quote: Students admitted to the Ph.D. degree program normally possess an M.Sc. degree in computer science or related area, with clear evidence of research ability or potential.

toefl_min.quote: 120-point scale for tests taken prior to Jan 21, 2026 | Overall score requirement: 100
